reviews.text: Kind of made me break out but maybe I wasn’t introducing it into my routine slow enough I usually love skin1004 products
reviews.zh: 用完有少少爆瘡，但可能係我加入護膚程序嘅速度唔夠慢，我平時好鍾意 skin1004 嘅產品

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Fresh Ampoule 50ml
reviews.text: I highly recommend this serum. It has a lightweight, silky texture that absorbs quickly into the skin without feeling greasy. With consistent use, it helps improve skin hydration, smoothness, and overall glow. The serum feels refreshing and leaves the skin looking healthier and more radiant. It’s easy to incorporate into a daily skincare routine and works well both morning and night.
reviews.zh: 我極推薦呢款精華。質地輕盈絲滑，吸收得好快，唔會油笠。持續使用有助改善皮膚水分、平滑度同整體光澤。精華用落清爽，用完皮膚睇落更健康更有光澤。容易加入日常護膚程序，無論日夜都用得。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Fresh Ampoule 50ml
reviews.text: I really like this ampoule. It moisturizes my skin very well and the tiny granules feel like a gentle massage on my face. It feels very nice and soothing, and my skin feels soft and refreshed after using it.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款安瓶。保濕效果好好，細細粒嘅粒子搽上面好似溫和按摩咁。用落好舒服好舒緩，用完皮膚感覺柔軟清爽。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Fresh Ampoule 50ml
reviews.text: Arrived today, the SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Fresh Ampoule 50ml feels fabulous, didnt really notice a scent. Went on well, absorbed quickly, didnt overdry nor make my skin feel oily —Skin looks smoother and feels more moisturized yet I seem to have less oil than I usually do. I recommend as it seems quite balancing for problematic skin.
reviews.zh: 今日到貨，SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Fresh Ampoule 50ml 感覺超好，幾乎聞唔到有味道。搽上去好順，吸收得快，唔會過度乾燥亦唔會令皮膚覺得油笠——皮膚睇落更滑，感覺更保濕，但我嘅出油量似乎比平時少。我推薦呢支，因為對問題肌膚嚟講好平衡。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Fresh Ampoule 50ml
reviews.text: This ampoule feels very light and refreshing on the skin. It absorbs quickly, provides good hydration, and helps calm any redness or irritation. I like that it’s gentle and doesn’t cause breakouts, making it perfect for daily use even on sensitive skin.
reviews.zh: 呢支安瓶搽喺皮膚上感覺非常清爽輕盈。吸收得快，保濕效果好，亦有助舒緩泛紅同刺激。鍾意佢夠溫和，唔會引致爆瘡，就算敏感肌都適合每日使用。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Fresh Ampoule 50ml
reviews.text: I've been using the SKIN1004 Probio-Cica Pink Ampoule for a few weeks, and I really like it! The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly into the skin without feeling sticky. It gives my skin a nice glow and helps soothe redness, especially when my skin feels irritated. I have oily skin with visible pores, and this ampoule doesn’t clog them or make me break out. The scent is very gentle and pleasant. I also love that it contains probiotics and centella – it feels calming and nourishing. Overall, it’s a great product for sensitive or stressed skin.
reviews.zh: 我用 SKIN1004 Probio-Cica Pink Ampoule 已經幾個星期，真心鍾意！質地輕盈，吸收快，唔會黏笠。皮膚即時有水光感，泛紅都舒緩咗，尤其係皮膚受刺激嗰陣。我係油性肌，毛孔明顯，但呢支安瓶唔會塞毛孔，亦唔會令我爆瘡。味道非常溫和討好。我亦好鍾意佢含有益生菌同積雪草——感覺舒緩又有營養。整體嚟講，對敏感肌或受壓肌膚係一流嘅產品。

reviews.text:
Físicas y Mecánicas de los Materiales
Introducción
Las propiedades mecánicas de un material determinan su comportamiento cuando 
se le sujeta a esfuerzos mecánicos. Estas propiedades incluyen el módulo de 
elasticidad, ductilidad, dureza y distintas medidas de la resistencia. Las 
propiedades mecánicas son importantes en el diseño porque el funcionamiento y 
rendimiento de un producto dependen de su capacidad para resistir la deformación 
ante los esfuerzos a que se le somete durante su uso. En el diseño, el objetivo 
usual del producto y sus componentes consiste en resistir dichos esfuerzos sin 
que su geometría cambie en forma significativa. Esta capacidad depende de 
propiedades tales como el módulo de elasticidad y la resistencia a la deformación. 
En la manufactura el objetivo es el opuesto. En ella se desea aplicar esfuerzos 
que excedan la resistencia a la deformación del material a fin de alterar su forma. 
Procesos mecánicos tales
reviews.zh:
材料嘅物理及機械性質
簡介
材料嘅機械性質決定咗佢受到機械應力時嘅表現。呢啲特性包括彈性模量、延展性、硬度同各種強度指標。機械性質喺設計上好重要，因為產品嘅功能同表現取決於佢能唔能夠抵受使用時受到嘅應力而唔變形。喺設計入面，產品同佢嘅部件一般嘅目標係抵受呢啲應力之餘，幾何形狀唔會有明顯改變。呢種能力取決於彈性模量同抗變形強度等特性。喺製造方面，目標就剛好相反——係要施加超過材料抗變形強度嘅應力去改變佢嘅形狀。機械加工等

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Fresh Ampoule 50ml
reviews.text: Tried this ampoule for a few weeks now and it’s been great. It sinks in quickly and feels really nice on the skin. My skin looks clearer and my pores don’t seem as noticeable. Definitely happy with it.
reviews.zh: 用咗呢支安瓶幾星期，效果好好。快速吸收，搽喺皮膚上感覺好舒服。皮膚睇落清咗，毛孔都冇咁明顯。絕對滿意。
